boundary: PASS proves proposition-aware lens selection, compound-type detection, structural receipt closure, VAJRA→GUT referential continuity, and replay-amplification guards across both branches and repeated applications. Compound detection is an auditable lexical heuristic and does not claim semantic clause parsing. A provenance+material payload already consumed by a prior VAJRA result cannot be relabelled later to close another branch. Rejection is structural and auditable, not a semantic truth judgment.
